from solution import inversion_elements


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: inversion_elements((7, 8, 9, 1, 10, 7)) == (-8, -9, -10, -2, -11, -8)."""
    # -7-1=-8, -8-1=-9, -9-1=-10, -1-1=-2, -10-1=-11, -7-1=-8
    assert inversion_elements((7, 8, 9, 1, 10, 7)) == (-8, -9, -10, -2, -11, -8)


def test_issue_empty():
    """Inversions of an empty tuple is an empty tuple as per element-wise rule."""
    # no elements, so expected () with no arithmetic needed
    assert inversion_elements(()) == ()


def test_issue_zero():
    """Inversion maps 0 to -1 as in the example rule x -> -x-1."""
    # -0-1=-1
    assert inversion_elements((0,)) == (-1,)


def test_issue_one():
    """Inversion maps 1 to -2 as in the example rule x -> -x-1."""
    # -1-1=-2
    assert inversion_elements((1,)) == (-2,)


def test_issue_negative_one():
    """Inversion maps -1 to 0 as in the example rule x -> -x-1."""
    # -(-1)-1=1-1=0
    assert inversion_elements((-1,)) == (0,)


def test_issue_positive_sequence():
    """Inversions map each element x to -x-1 as in the example."""
    # -0-1=-1, -1-1=-2, -2-1=-3
    assert inversion_elements((0, 1, 2)) == (-1, -2, -3)


def test_issue_negative_sequence():
    """Inversions map each element x to -x-1 as in the example."""
    # -(-2)-1=2-1=1, -(-3)-1=3-1=2
    assert inversion_elements((-2, -3)) == (1, 2)


def test_issue_mixed_signs():
    """Inversions map each element x to -x-1 as in the example."""
    # -5-1=-6, -(-5)-1=5-1=4, -0-1=-1
    assert inversion_elements((5, -5, 0)) == (-6, 4, -1)


def test_issue_large_and_duplicate():
    """Inversions map each element x to -x-1 as in the example."""
    # -100-1=-101, -7-1=-8, -7-1=-8
    assert inversion_elements((100, 7, 7)) == (-101, -8, -8)


def test_contract_tuple_type():
    """Result is a tuple as shown in the example."""
    # -1-1=-2, -2-1=-3 so expected tuple is (-2, -3)
    result = inversion_elements((1, 2))
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)


def test_contract_length_preserved():
    """Result length equals input length as shown in the example (6 in, 6 out)."""
    # -4-1=-5, -5-1=-6, -6-1=-7 so expected (-5, -6, -7) has length 3
    assert len(inversion_elements((4, 5, 6))) == 3
